persona: GeoTech Office Chief (GEOTECH_OFFICE_CHIEF / legacy OFFICE_CHIEF), first day, no training, 13-inch laptop. Lands on /my-work after sign-in (web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx:42). Sidebar shows Workspace › My Work, Operations › Mission Center / Event Groups / Incidents / Assessments, GIS Tools › Terrain Cross Sections, Account › Settings (web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx:72-104). Header shows the raw role code 'GEOTECH_OFFICE_CHIEF' next to the name (AppShell.tsx:157). All three tasks are performed on the My Work queue (web/src/features/myWork/MyWorkPage.tsx) and the shared assessment panel (web/src/features/assessments/AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx); the office-wide picture must come from Operations › Assessments (web/src/features/assessments/AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx).

tasks.task: See which assessments are waiting for my delegation and delegate one to a branch chief, assigning the engineer directly when I know who should take it
steps: Sign in; land on My Work with the line '<N> items waiting on your role' and a rail of cards (MyWorkPage.tsx:120-138).

Scan the rail for cards whose mini badge reads 'Pending office delegation' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:434-437; label from assessmentModel.ts:54). Every card in my queue reads 'Waiting on Office Chief', so I must rely on the badge text to separate delegation items from 'Approved' items.
Click one card. On a 13-inch laptop at 1280 CSS px or wider the detail panel appears to the right; at any narrower effective width it renders below the up-to-860px-tall rail (MyWorkPage.tsx:136-137).

Read the header 'Assessment #12 / Incident #40 · <title> / North GeoTech Office · District 7 · Updated …', the six-dot pipeline with 'Office delegation' active, and the Next step card 'Waiting on Office Chief — Delegate this assessment to a branch chief — or assign the engineer directly.' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:232-265; assessmentModel.ts:78).

Look for the report context. The panel offers only 'Open incident', 'View on map', 'Event Group #N' buttons (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:241-243) and, far below, the 'Assessment history' card whose first event is 'Created · Assessment Required by <coordinator>' with any triage notes (390-401). Open the incident in the same tab if I need photos/description, then use the browser Back button (no breadcrumb or back link in the shell).
Optionally type into the textarea whose only label is the placeholder 'Optional workflow notes' (294).
Open 'Select branch chief…' and pick 'Name · email' (298-301).
Open 'Assign engineer now (optional)…' and pick the engineer (302-305).

Click the small 'Delegate' button (306). It is disabled until a branch chief is chosen. No confirmation; the card disappears and the panel silently switches to the first remaining item (MyWorkPage.tsx:88, 99-104). No success message is shown for assessment actions (notice is only set by triage, MyWorkPage.tsx:177).

frictionPoints.step: Scanning the rail for delegation items
frictionPoints.problem: Delegation items and approved-to-finalize items are mixed in one unfiltered list, and both show 'Waiting on Office Chief'; reviewer items I was assigned may also be present. There is no grouping, count per kind, or filter.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: MyWorkPage.tsx:52-57 merges office_chief queue, APPROVED list and reviewer queue into one rail sorted by updated_at (71); the only differentiator is the small badge text (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:435). A newcomer asked 'what is waiting for delegation' has to read every badge.

frictionPoints.problem: The panel gives no incident context inline — no description, reporter photos, incident type, or routing explanation — only three buttons that navigate away, and the triage notes are buried at the bottom of the history card.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:241-243 links out; the incident title is fetched only for the heading (176-187). The chief must leave My Work to judge the case, and the shell has no back affordance (AppShell.tsx:141-144, 184), so returning means browser Back and re-selecting the card since selection is not in the URL (MyWorkPage.tsx:148).

frictionPoints.problem: Neither select has a visible label; after a value is chosen both fields display the same 'Full name · email' format, so it is easy to lose track of which field is the branch chief and which is the engineer.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: Placeholder-only options at AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:299 and 303; both use the identical option template (300, 304).

frictionPoints.problem: When I already know the engineer, I still cannot press Delegate until a branch chief is chosen, and nothing explains why the button is disabled. Nothing tells me that naming an engineer skips the branch chief's queue entirely.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: Delegate is disabled on !branchChiefId (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:306) with no helper text; the Next step sentence says 'or assign the engineer directly' (assessmentModel.ts:78), which reads as an alternative to picking a branch chief, but the UI treats it as an addition. The server-side consequence — assessment goes straight to DRAFT and the branch chief never sees it (backend/app/routes/assessments.py:1008-1018) — is invisible in the UI.

frictionPoints.problem: Single click, no confirmation, no success notice; the panel jumps to a different assessment, so a first-time user is unsure whether the delegation happened or they mis-clicked into another record.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: run() calls onChanged and clears the form (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:208-220); MyWorkPage falls back to items[0] when the selected id disappears (88) and only triage sets the green notice (177). The only trace is that the card is gone.

frictionPoints.step: Seeing 'Add reviewer…' in the Assignments card at the delegation step
frictionPoints.problem: The reviewer picker is visible before delegation, with no guidance on whether a reviewer must be added now, later, or by the branch chief.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: permissions.addReviewer is true in every non-FINALIZED state (assessmentModel.ts:133) and the control sits in the card header (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:366-376), separate from the Next step card. The job model says review is blocked until someone is assigned, but nothing in the UI says when to do it.

frictionPoints.problem: Rail shows raw codes 'Office NORTH · D7' while the panel spells 'North GeoTech Office · District 7'; the incident title is absent from the card, so cards are distinguishable only by number.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:434 vs 234; incident title is only fetched for the selected detail (176-187).

frictionPoints.problem: If delegation fails (e.g. server 403 'Incident is outside your assigned office'), the message appears in a banner at the very top of the page above the rail, not next to the Delegate button, and persists across item switches.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: onError feeds MyWorkPage.tsx:127; the panel has no inline error slot. On a scaled 13-inch screen (single column) the banner may be off-screen above the rail.

steps: Open My Work (default landing). Scan the rail for a card with the green 'Approved' mini badge and 'Waiting on Office Chief' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:435-437; assessmentModel.ts:45, 59).

Click the card. Header shows the state badge 'Approved', the pipeline with 'Approval' active, and the Next step card 'Waiting on Office Chief — Finalize the assessment to close out the workflow.' (assessmentModel.ts:87-88).

Check the 'Technical submissions' table: rows show '#id', descriptor link, a raw status badge, reporter as 'You' or 'User #7', created/submitted dates and an 'Open' button that leaves the page to /submissions/:id (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:336-364).
Check 'Assignments' (engineer and reviewer names) and 'Assessment history' for the 'Approved' event and the reviewer's note (378-401).
Optionally type in 'Optional workflow notes'.
Click the green 'Finalize assessment' button (328). No confirmation; the item leaves the queue and the panel switches to the next item with no success message.

frictionPoints.step: Choosing which approved card to finalize
frictionPoints.problem: The APPROVED list in My Work is statewide, not office-scoped, but the finalize endpoint rejects assessments outside my office. A first-day chief sees approved assessments from other offices listed under 'items waiting on your role', clicks Finalize and gets 'Incident is outside your assigned office' in the top banner.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: MyWorkPage.tsx:56 calls listAssessments({ state: 'APPROVED' }) without the office_chief queue, so backend _scope_office is never applied (backend/app/routes/assessments.py:803-806, 858-868); finalize_assessment enforces _ensure_incident_office_access (assessments.py:1461; incidents.py:502-508). The queue promises the item is mine; the server says it is not.

frictionPoints.problem: The assessment already reads 'Approved' in green; the instruction 'close out the workflow' does not say what finalizing changes, whether it is reversible, or that the incident itself stays open until an engineer resolves it.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: Only text is assessmentModel.ts:88 and the post-action banner 'Workflow complete. Finalized <date>' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:249-252). Nothing mentions that incident resolution is a separate step owned by the engineer, so a chief will believe the case is closed.

frictionPoints.problem: Terminal, irreversible transition fires on one click with no confirmation, and success is signalled only by the card vanishing and the panel jumping to another record.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:328 and run() 208-220; MyWorkPage.tsx:88 auto-selects the next item; no notice for assessment actions.

frictionPoints.step: Reviewing the approved report before finalizing
frictionPoints.problem: To read the approved technical submission the chief must click 'Open' which navigates to /submissions/:id and out of My Work; the table also shows the reporter as 'User #7' and the status as a raw enum.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:352-357; SubmissionStatusBadge prints the raw status (web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDetailPrimitives.tsx). No back link on return; My Work selection is lost.

frictionPoints.problem: It is unclear where 'Optional workflow notes' go or who reads them.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: Placeholder-only label (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:294); notes surface only later as an event note in the history card (400).

frictionPoints.step: Locating the panel on a scaled 13-inch display
frictionPoints.problem: Below 1280 CSS px (e.g. 1920×1080 at 175% scaling) the detail panel renders under an 860px rail and clicking a card does not scroll to it.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: Two-column layout is xl-only (MyWorkPage.tsx:136-137); no scroll-into-view on selection (148).

tasks.task: Get a picture of all active assessments in my office and where they are stuck
steps: Start on My Work. Realise it lists only steps waiting on me (delegation, approved, reviewer); assessments sitting with a branch chief or engineer are absent. The only pointer to another view is the empty-state sentence 'Browse the records under Operations › Assessments' (MyWorkPage.tsx:133), which is not shown while the queue has items.
Try the sidebar: 'Mission Center' (map), 'Event Groups', 'Incidents', 'Assessments'. Pick Operations › Assessments (AppShell.tsx:87).

Read the banner 'Read-only record view of every assessment…' and the toolbar: state select ('All states' + 7 states), search box 'Search assessments, incidents, or submissions', '<n> of <m> assessments', Refresh (AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:104-116).

Scan the rail: 'Assessment #12 / Incident #40 · Office NORTH · D7 / badge / Waiting on Branch Chief / submission line'. Notice assessments from Office SOUTH and WEST are mixed in — the list is statewide (AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:49 calls listAssessments({ limit: 1000 }) with no office filter).
Guess at narrowing to my office: there is no office filter; typing 'NORTH' into search happens to match office_code (assessmentModel.ts:156) but nothing suggests this.

Switch the state filter one value at a time (Pending office delegation, Pending engineer assignment, Draft, Submitted for review, Revision requested) and note the '<n> of <m>' count each time to build a picture.

Click a card to see its 'Updated <date>' in the header (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:234), the pipeline dot, the engineer's name in 'Waiting on Engineer · Name' (only for the selected card), and the history timestamps. Repeat per assessment to judge how long each has been stuck.
If a step is mine, click 'This step is yours — act on it in My Work' (269) to hop back.

frictionPoints.step: Looking for the office overview from My Work
frictionPoints.problem: My Work is a personal step queue, not an office portfolio; the label 'items waiting on your role' invites the interpretation 'everything in my office', and the pointer to the Assessments record view is hidden unless the queue is empty.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: MyWorkPage.tsx:52-57 fetch only office_chief, APPROVED and reviewer queues; the cross-link at 133 renders only in the empty state. A chief with pending work never sees the hint.

frictionPoints.step: Narrowing the Assessments list to my office
frictionPoints.problem: The record view is statewide with no office (or district) filter; office appears only as a raw code on each card. The backend supports office_code filtering but the UI never uses it.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:49, 104-111 (state + text search only); backend list_assessments accepts office_code (backend/app/routes/assessments.py:785, 807-809) but web/src/api/assessments.ts is called without it. Search matching office_code (assessmentModel.ts:156) is undocumented.

frictionPoints.problem: Rail cards carry no dates, ages or 'stuck since' indicator, and the list is sorted most-recently-updated first, so the stalest assessments sink to the bottom of a scrolling 860px rail.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentRailCard shows id, office/district, badge, waiting-on, submissions only (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:431-445); ORDER BY updated_at DESC (assessments.py:846); updated_at is visible only in the detail header (234). The core question 'what has been sitting with whom for how long' needs one click per record.

frictionPoints.problem: Cards say 'Waiting on Branch Chief' or 'Waiting on Assigned Engineer' without a person's name; the engineer's name appears only after the card is selected.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: assignments are passed only for the loaded detail (AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:128), so waitingOn falls back to the generic label (assessmentModel.ts:75). Branch chief names are never shown at all — branch_chief_user_id is not rendered.

frictionPoints.problem: There are no per-state counts; the only number is '<n> of <m>', so the chief must cycle the state filter five times to tally the pipeline.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:105-110, 122; the count is even duplicated in the rail header instead of being broken down.

frictionPoints.problem: 'All states' includes Finalized records; there is no 'active only' option, so completed work pollutes the overview.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: State select lists ASSESSMENT_STATES including FINALIZED (AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:106-107; assessmentModel.ts:9-17) with no multi-select or exclusion.

frictionPoints.problem: Rail cards show 'Incident #40' but not the incident title or location, so the chief cannot recognise a case without clicking it.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:434; the assessment list payload carries district but not location/title, and the title is fetched per selected item only (176-187).

frictionPoints.step: Choosing between Mission Center, Event Groups, Incidents and Assessments
frictionPoints.problem: Four sibling 'Operations' entries with no descriptions; a newcomer may try Mission Center or Incidents first for an office picture.
frictionPoints.whyConfusing: AppShell.tsx:84-87 nav labels only; the Assessments page's own banner explains it only once inside.

firstDayConfusions: My Work vs Assessments: both pages have an identical rail+detail layout and the same cards, but one is 'act' and one is 'browse'; the difference is stated only in a grey banner on Assessments (AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:114-116) and in the empty state of My Work (MyWorkPage.tsx:133).
Every card in the office chief's queue says 'Waiting on Office Chief' — never 'Waiting on you' — so it is not obvious that the list is personal (assessmentModel.ts:78, 88).
'Delegate' requires a branch chief even when the engineer is named, and naming an engineer silently bypasses the branch chief (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:306; backend assessments.py:1008-1018).
Approved ≠ Finalized ≠ Resolved: three closure words, with no explanation of what Finalize changes or that the incident stays open (assessmentModel.ts:88; AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:249-252).
Approved assessments from other offices appear in My Work and fail with a server 403 on Finalize (MyWorkPage.tsx:56 vs assessments.py:1461).
No success feedback for Delegate/Finalize: the card disappears and the panel jumps to a different assessment (MyWorkPage.tsx:88; AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:208-220).
Unlabeled selects with placeholder-only prompts and identical 'Name · email' option formats (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:298-305); unlabeled 'Optional workflow notes' textarea (294).
'Add reviewer…' appears in the Assignments card at every step with no cue about when reviewers must be added (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:366-376; assessmentModel.ts:133).

Raw codes everywhere: 'GEOTECH_OFFICE_CHIEF' in the header (AppShell.tsx:157), 'Office NORTH · D7' on cards (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:434), 'User #7' as reporter (354), raw submission status enum (353).
No office filter anywhere on the Assessments page even though the persona is defined by office (AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:104-111).
Rail cards have no dates, so 'how long has this been stuck' cannot be answered without opening each record (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:431-445).
Leaving the panel via 'Open incident' or 'Open' submission loses the My Work selection; the shell has no back link or breadcrumb (AppShell.tsx:141-144, 184; MyWorkPage.tsx:148).
On a 13-inch laptop with display scaling below 1280 CSS px the detail panel sits under an 860px rail and clicking a card does not scroll to it (MyWorkPage.tsx:136-148).
Vocabulary drift within one panel: 'technical submission', 'GISA form', 'Submission' (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:288, 336, 339).
mentalModelGaps: Job model: 'my office's caseload, grouped by who has it and how long' — software model: a personal inbox of individual steps (My Work) plus a statewide read-only record list (Assessments) with no office dimension.

Job model: delegation is either to a branch chief OR directly to an engineer — software model: branch chief is always required and the engineer is an optional add-on that changes routing without saying so (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:302-306; assessments.py:1008-1018).

Job model: the office chief approves/closes a case — software model: a reviewer 'Approves', the chief 'Finalizes' the assessment, and the engineer or admin 'Resolves' the incident later; the chief's screen never mentions the last step.

Job model: reviewer/approver assignment is part of routing the case — software model: it is a detached 'Add reviewer…' control in the Assignments card at any state, not part of the Next step (AssessmentDetailPanel.tsx:366-376).

Job model: an assessment is about a site (D/C/R/PM, slide, photos) — software model: an assessment is a numbered record with an incident number, office code and pipeline dot; site context is one or two navigations away (241-243).

Job model: 'my office' is a named place (North GeoTech Office) — software model: office is a code in card text and a hidden server scope that applies to some queues but not others (MyWorkPage.tsx:52 vs 56; assessments.py:858-868).
Job model: 'stuck' means old and unmoved — software model: nothing surfaces age; lists sort newest-first and cards omit timestamps.
topFixes: Group the My Work rail into labelled sections with counts — 'To delegate (3)', 'To finalize (1)', 'To review (2)' — and change 'Waiting on Office Chief' to 'Waiting on you' for the signed-in role.

Scope the APPROVED-to-finalize list to the chief's office (use the office_chief scoping or pass office_code from the user's metadata in MyWorkPage.tsx:56) so no item in My Work can fail with 'outside your assigned office'.
Add an Office filter (default: my office) and an 'Active only' toggle to the Assessments record view, plus a per-state count strip; show the office as its name, not 'Office NORTH'.
Put age on every rail card ('Updated 6 days ago', 'In this step since …') and offer a 'Longest waiting first' sort so stuck items rise to the top.

Rework the delegation form: visible labels ('Branch chief' / 'Engineer (optional)'), a helper line under Delegate explaining why it is disabled, and an explicit note that choosing an engineer sends the assessment straight to Draft and skips the branch chief's queue.

Show a success toast/banner after Delegate, Finalize and other assessment actions ('Assessment #12 delegated to <name>'), keep the user on a summary of what just happened instead of auto-selecting the next record, and add a confirmation step for Finalize with one sentence on what it does and does not close.

Surface incident context inline in the panel (title, location, description excerpt, first photo, coordinator triage notes/routing override) so the chief can delegate without leaving My Work; add a 'Back to My Work' link on incident and submission pages.

Move reviewer assignment into the Next step card at delegation time ('Also assign a reviewer for the engineering write-up') with a one-line explanation that review is blocked until someone is assigned.

Replace raw codes with names: humanise role codes in the header, show the branch chief's and engineer's names on unselected cards, replace 'User #7' with the reporter name and the raw submission status with the humanised label.
Add a one-line pipeline glossary or hover text for Approved → Finalized → Resolved so the chief knows finalization does not close the incident.
